# OSIEN Probe (v1.0.5)

> Offline static source analysis (1,142+ ultra rules), 11-language tree-sitter AST call graphs, deep Live Website URL auditor with auto-fix config generator, secret scanner, and zero-dependency stdio MCP server by OSIEN.

## Links
- [OSIEN Probe Homepage](https://osienprobe.vercel.app/): Interactive 3D showcase, live scan preview, and quickstart.
- [OSIEN Probe Documentation](https://osienprobe.vercel.app/#docs): Visual architecture diagrams for humans and MCP/CLI specs for AI agents.
- [OSIEN Probe History & Roadmap](https://osienprobe.vercel.app/#history): Visual timeline from DeepCheck to OSIEN Probe v1.0.5 and upcoming v1.1+ milestones.
- [Dive In — OSIEN Ecosystem Ocean](https://osienprobe.vercel.app/#dive-in): Interactive deep-ocean SVG map of all 10 verified working OSIEN projects.
- [OSIEN Probe GitHub Repository](https://github.com/kabirprokk/OSIEN-Probe): Source code, native Windows/macOS/Linux desktop app, CLI, and MCP server (MIT license).
- [OSIEN Parent Organization](https://osien.is-a.dev/): The broader OSIEN software and developer tooling ecosystem.

## Core Capabilities (v1.0.5)
- Zero code execution: Static analysis only; no project code is executed during a scan.
- 1,142+ rules & 11-language AST call graphs: Babel for JS/TS plus 11 `@ast-grep` tree-sitter grammars (Python, Go, Rust, Java, PHP, Ruby, Kotlin, C/C++, Swift, C#, Bash) with CFG compound guard narrowing.
- Deep Live Website URL Auditor: Multi-page same-origin crawl (`--crawl <n>`), HTTPS TLS inspection, CORS reflection probe (`--probe-cors`), exposed `/.git/HEAD` & `/.env` check (`--probe-exposed`), and Live Web Fix Generator (`--fix nginx|apache|express|nextjs|vercel|cloudflare|all`).
- Same-file & cross-file taint tracking: Tracks input-to-sink flows and recognizes sanitizers (`DOMPurify.sanitize`, `encodeURIComponent`, `path.basename`).
- Entropy secret scanning: Flags AWS, GitHub PAT, Stripe, OpenAI, Anthropic, Slack, GCP, and private keys.
- Multi-provider AI verification: Local Ollama (`qwen3.5:0.8b`), Claude, OpenCode, and Pi providers with fast-fail circuit breaker.
- Native Desktop App: Single-instance lock, drag-and-drop folders, deep Live URL audit with Save Config, and custom Windows NSIS installer.
- Reports & CI gating: SARIF 2.1.0, Markdown, JSON, and `--fail-on <severity>`.

## CLI & MCP Usage
- Interactive TUI: `probe`
- Static project scan: `probe scan <path> --kind "Website" --sarif --fail-on high`
- Live URL audit + fix config: `probe scan https://your-site.com --crawl 5 --probe-cors --probe-exposed --fix vercel`
- MCP stdio server: `node bin/osien-probe-mcp.cjs` (tools: `scan_project`, `inspect_finding_context`, `verify_finding_with_ai`, `list_rules`)
